meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会掌握 Codex Rules 的规格，能解释规则文件的注入时机、支持的项目源路径、环境变量配置，以及动态输出的去重逻辑。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex 规则如何工作、规则文件位置或环境配置等问题时，Claude 会依据本说明回答。

say.text: Codex 的规则文件一般放在哪些位置？
say.note: Claude 会列出支持的项目源路径。

say.text: 怎么用环境变量关闭 Codex Rules？
say.note: Claude 会说明相关变量及用法。

say.text: 动态规则注入和静态注入有什么区别？
say.note: Claude 会解释两种模式及去重行为。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will know the full spec of Codex Rules and can accurately explain injection timing, supported project source paths, environment variable configuration, and dynamic output deduplication logic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about how Codex Rules works, rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration; Claude will answer based on this spec.

say_en.text: Where should Codex rule files typically be placed?
say_en.note: Claude will list supported project sources.

say_en.text: How do I turn off Codex Rules via env var?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the relevant variables.

say_en.text: What's the difference between static and dynamic injection?
say_en.note: Claude will clarify modes and dedup.
